posts.title: Faça Pausas Breves, Movimente-se!
posts.excerpt: Levante-se a cada hora para alongar ou caminhar um pouco. Isso alivia a tensão muscular, melhora a circulação e aumenta a produtividade.

posts.title: Take Short Breaks, Move!
posts.excerpt: Stand up every hour to stretch or walk briefly. This relieves muscle tension, improves circulation, and boosts productivity and focus.
posts.content: Stand up every hour to stretch or walk briefly. This relieves muscle tension, improves circulation, and boosts productivity and focus.
posts.author: RGR Saúde (IA)

posts.title: ¡Haz Pausas Breves, Muévete!
posts.excerpt: Ponte de pie cada hora para estirar o caminar un poco. Esto alivia la tensión muscular, mejora la circulación y aumenta la productividad y el enfoque.
posts.content: Ponte de pie cada hora para estirar o caminar un poco. Esto alivia la tensión muscular, mejora la circulación y aumenta la productividad y el enfoque.

posts.title: Stay Hydrated: Water is Vital!
posts.excerpt: Stay hydrated throughout the day. Water improves concentration, fights fatigue, and optimizes your energy levels. Keep a bottle nearby.

posts.title: Mindful Eating: Healthy Snacks
posts.excerpt: Choose nutritious snacks to maintain energy. Fruits, nuts, and yogurt are great options. Avoid sugary treats that cause energy spikes and crashes.
